checks: The trim lemma supplies exact ε times each selected column mixture and o(ε) interaction in the stated dimensions. The equal-slope expansion uses the full original mixed measure in every row. No assertion is made for unequal slopes.

The chosen shifts have zero circuit-weighted sum because a_p is defined using weights proportional to ρ_j/S_j. The common leading mass is Q−εa_p in each deep group and the old nondeep caps remain slack. Finite groups permit taking a uniform error and division by M−ε yields (β−τ)/M.

Separation of the compact column hull from the strict upper orthant supplies nonnegative dual weights. The reverse min–max inequality is the elementary comparison with the dual average. A support column of an optimal strategy has tight dual payoff, so its lifted column lies in a hyperplane of dimension at most |I|. A nonzero dependence preserves every row and the total weight and permits dropping one positive weight.

The fiberwise Hausdorff convergence of the actual cuts makes τ>β impossible at an unrestricted local minimum. The restricted-class clause only applies when these paths are admissible. This is a conditional descent criterion without a claim that below-target depth forces a profitable strategy.
Checked the exact source locators and matched all archived candidate hashes against the pinned graph.
